articles.title: TheTeacher AI - Empowering Zimbabwe's Educators
articles.description: AI-powered WhatsApp chatbot supporting teachers from ECD to Form 6 across Zimbabwe, Botswana, and South Africa.
articles.contents:
TheTeacher AI
Transforming Education Through AI
TheTeacher AI is an AI-powered WhatsApp chatbot designed to support teachers in under-resourced areas across Zimbabwe, Botswana, and South Africa.
Key Features
Curriculum-Aligned Support - Instant pedagogical advice for ECD to Form 6
Lesson Plan Generation - Create structured lesson plans in seconds
Assessment Creation - Generate learning assessments tailored to student levels
Accessible - Works on basic mobile phones via WhatsApp
Low-Cost - No high-speed internet required
Impact
Empowering educators in remote communities with professional development support and classroom management strategies.
Contact Us

Botswana: +267 71 505 830
South Africa: +27 69 580 1598
